(6) It recommends detaching the volume and running fsck on an unmounted filesystem via a rescue-type approach ("stop the instance... detach/attach the root volume to a rescue instance, run fsck on the unmounted filesystem"). While it doesn't explicitly mention "snapshot and replace the volume" as an option, it covers the core remediation path (volume health check, detach, fsck on rescue instance) and the central caution against remounting rw. The response substantively satisfies the expected output.
